content.text: Here is your official cheat sheet to the most critical tax dates you need to know. In this video, we break down the most important IRS tax dates you’ll encounter throughout the year so you can stay compliant, avoid penalties, and feel confident going into tax season. We’ll walk through the major filing deadlines, extension windows, contribution cutoffs, and key milestones for businesses, individuals, and anyone earning income without withholding. Whether you file as an employee, run a business, or are self-employed, this timeline will be your go-to cheat sheet for the entire year. What you'll learn: • The key early-year deadlines for employer tax forms • Important business tax filing dates for partnerships, S-corps, and C-corps • The major April milestones for filings, contributions, and retirement rules • Mid- and late-year deadlines for extended returns • The quarterly estimated tax dates self-employed taxpayers must track • How these dates affect penalties, refunds, and IRS compliance • How to build a simple tax-deadline calendar to stay organized • How QuickBooks helps automate reminders and reduce tax-season stress This content is for information purposes only and should not be considered legal, accounting or tax advice, or a substitute for obtaining such advice specific to your business.
